compose:
name: clipflow
services:
  api:
    build:
      context: D:\Projects\ClipFlow
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://clipflow:local-demo-password@db:5432/clipflow?sslmode=disable
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: clipflow
      S3_BUCKET: clips
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_SECRET_KEY: local-demo-storage-password
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - -f
        - http://localhost:8080/readyz
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 2s
      retries: 30
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 8080
        published: "8080"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
  db:
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: clipflow
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: local-demo-password
      POSTGRES_USER: clipflow
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -U clipflow -d clipflow
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 2s
      retries: 30
    image: postgres:18.3-bookworm
    networks:
      default: null
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: database
        target: /var/lib/postgresql
        volume: {}
  minio:
    build:
      context: D:\Projects\ClipFlow
      dockerfile: docker/minio.Dockerfile
    command:
      - server
      - /data
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: local-demo-storage-password
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: clipflow
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - -f
        - http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 2s
      retries: 30
    networks:
      default: null
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: objects
        target: /data
        volume: {}
  web:
    build:
      context: D:\Projects\ClipFlow\web
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        host_ip: 127.0.0.1
        target: 5173
        published: "5173"
        protocol: tcp
  worker:
    build:
      context: D:\Projects\ClipFlow
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: runtime
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: 1
          memory: "536870912"
    entrypoint:
      - worker
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://clipflow:local-demo-password@db:5432/clipflow?sslmode=disable
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: clipflow
      S3_BUCKET: clips
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_SECRET_KEY: local-demo-storage-password
    networks:
      default: null
    restart: unless-stopped
networks:
  default:
    name: clipflow_default
volumes:
  database:
    name: clipflow_database
  objects:
    name: clipflow_objects
x-app:
  build:
    context: .
    target: runtime
  depends_on:
    db:
      condition: service_healthy
    minio:
      condition: service_healthy
  environment:
    DATABASE_URL: postgres://clipflow:local-demo-password@db:5432/clipflow?sslmode=disable
    S3_ACCESS_KEY: clipflow
    S3_BUCKET: clips
    S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
    S3_SECRET_KEY: local-demo-storage-password
  restart: unless-stopped
